text: みがわり　つかえる　のは　ポケモンだけ　だけどね…　みがわり　おしえて　あげようか？

structure.jp: みがわり　つかえる　のは
structure.en: the ones who can use Substitute

structure.jp: ポケモンだけ　だけどね…
みがわり　おしえて　あげようか？

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.span: おしえて　あげようか
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form verb says you do it as a favour for someone; あげようか turns that into an offer. おしえて　あげようか = 'shall I teach it for you?'

patterns.name: 〜のは〜だ
patterns.span: つかえる　のは　ポケモンだけ　だ
patterns.explanation: のは after a verb means 'the one that does this is...', saving the key piece for the end. つかえる　のは　ポケモンだけ　だ = 'the only ones who can use it are Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど at the end of a sentence means 'though', softening what was just said. ポケモンだけ　だけどね = 'it's only Pokémon, though'.
